About the role

As a Growth Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll drive expansion and retention of our fastest-growing startup customers by helping them harness the transformative potential of safe, frontier AI. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise to grow revenue while becoming a trusted strategic advisor, helping customers expand their AI capabilities and unlock new use cases. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$222,800—$290,000 USD

Logistics

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. Job Summary

As a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

In this high-visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high-performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI-native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline.

This is a high-leverage "build-the-foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence-backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision.

• Establish Secure Seams & Extensions: Create localized plugin models so that new auth methods, protocol extensions, or tunnel types land once and become immediately available across all platforms.
• Systemic Quality & Reliability by Design: Own the endpoint architecture standardizing peer identity, least-privilege decomposition, resilient error handling, and memory safety directly into type systems and CI/CD gates.
• Pioneer AI-Native Workflows & Supportability: Integrate AI-driven software design, development, automated crash triage, and automated regression verification into standard build pipelines across millions of active enterprise endpoints.
• Drive Technical Excellence: Set engineering standards, author key Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), mentor principal and senior talent, and represent our technical strategy with customers and engineering partners.

• Windows: Kernel/driver models, WFP, services, OS process architecture.
• macOS: XPC, System/Network Extensions, IOKit, code-signing, notarization.
• Linux: Netlink, routing, network namespaces, DNS handling.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience shipping multi-platform agents at scale (millions of active endpoints) with staged rollouts and telemetry-backed observability.
• Background integrating AI/ML models into software engineering workflows.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

The Safeguards ML Inference Path team designs, builds, and operates the production infrastructure that powers Claude's ML based safety systems. We collaborate closely with safety researchers and inference engineers to bring new classifiers and novel classes of ML defenses to production. We own the research → production transfer of new safety technologies that is on the critical path for every Claude model launch. And we build for scale: serving thousands of ML classifiers, for all requests on the token generation path, and for every platform Claude runs on -- 1P, Bedrock, Vertex, and beyond.

We’re growing the team and looking for engineers who have deep expertise in productionizing ML systems. You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, large-scale distributed systems, and AI safety, developing the platforms and tools that enable our safeguards to operate reliably at scale. And your tooling and infrastructure will be used for every model launch, which are becoming more complex, and more frequent.

Responsibilities:

• Design and build scalable ML infrastructure to support real-time safety deployments across our classifier and model ecosystem
• Build monitoring and observability tools to track classifier performance, data quality, and system health for safety-critical applications
• Collaborate with research teams to productionize safety research, translating experimental safety techniques into robust, scalable systems
• Optimize inference latency and throughput for real-time safety evaluations while maintaining high reliability standards
• Implement automated testing, deployment, and rollback systems for ML models in production safety applications
• Partner with Safeguards, Security, and Alignment teams to understand requirements and deliver infrastructure that meets safety and production needs
• Contribute to the development of internal tools and frameworks that accelerate safety research and deployment

You may be a good fit if you:

To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers. As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces. Key job responsibilities As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for: • Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email • Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs • Upholding company values and respecting every customer • Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers • Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present • Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues • Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome • Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer • Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation • Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds • Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach • Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours • Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided) • Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled. A day in the life You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon. Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses. About the team Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues. Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity. About the Team

DoorDash’s centralized, global TPM organization helps Engineering deliver the company’s most complex and consequential technical, product, and business transformations. The team spans DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo and partners across a global Engineering organization of approximately 4,000 engineers.

We have intentionally built a lean, high-leverage TPM organization with a high bar for technical depth, business judgment, and independent domain ownership. Our leaders stay close to the business and technical work, lead through strong senior IC TPMs, and shape the operating mechanisms that allow complex organizations to execute at speed.

This Director will lead 12 TPMs (one-quarter of the global TPM organization) and report directly to the VP of Engineering Operations. Their team supports nearly 1,300 engineers across five strategically important organizations: Dasher & Logistics, Ads & Promotions, Merchant, DashOS, and Platform Services.

About the Role

As Director of Technical Program Management, you will lead a high-performing team of TPMs embedded across some of DoorDash’s most important and technically complex businesses. Your portfolio spans the real-time fulfillment network that powers every delivery, a multi-billion dollar ads revenue platform, DoorDash’s merchant ecosystem and in-store technology, and platforms that enable merchants and other businesses to access our logistics network through offerings such as Drive and Parcels.

You will partner closely with a VP and four Senior Directors to set direction, strengthen execution, develop TPM talent, and solve the cross-organizational challenges that sit between teams, systems, and business priorities. You will also play a central role in Pedregal, DoorDash’s multi-year global platform re-architecture across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo while maintaining production availability and continuing to build for each business’ evolving requirements.

We believe the future of TPM leadership is defined by leverage, not layers. This role is for a forward-looking leader who can develop an intentionally lean, high-performing team, use AI to amplify its impact, and shape strategy and organizational capability while remaining meaningfully connected to the work.

You must be located near San Francisco, CA, Sunnyvale, CA, or Seattle, WA for this hybrid position.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Lead and develop 12 TPMs supporting nearly 1,300 engineers across five strategic engineering organizations.
• Partner with senior Engineering and Product leaders to shape portfolio strategy, investment tradeoffs, technical sequencing, risk management, and organizational operating models.
• Help scale DoorDash’s core delivery network; accelerate the next several billion dollars of Ads growth; build the merchant operating system; and expand access to DoorDash logistics through Drive and Parcels.
• Establish durable mechanisms for execution, technical readiness, decision-making, and cross-functional alignment across highly interdependent organizations.
• Develop exceptional TPM talent and create an environment where senior ICs can own broad, strategic scope and serve as trusted partners to Engineering leadership.
• Help define the next evolution of a modern TPM organization, identifying the strategic initiatives, technical transformations, and organizational capabilities where AI-enabled ways of working can increase the pace and quality of execution.

We’re excited about you because you have…

• 12+ years of TPM experience, including 7+ years leading TPM teams. You have demonstrated success leading a team that supports a broad, complex technical portfolio in a high-growth technology company.
• Deep commitment to developing talent and building culture within your team, setting a high bar for technical depth, ownership, sound judgment, and independent execution. You hire, coach, and promote strong TPMs who are technical leaders, focus on outcomes over process, and consistently deliver business value while improving engineering efficiency and collaboration.
• The technical and business judgment to identify and align your team to the highest-impact opportunities as well as make thoughtful investment and sequencing tradeoffs.
• The technical credibility to engage with Engineering leaders on architecture, platform migrations, system dependencies, reliability, and risk, while translating that complexity into clear decisions and execution plans.
• A track record of leading large-scale, multi-year transformations that require alignment across multiple organizations, systems, products, and stakeholders.
• A strategic mindset that shapes how engineering delivers. You consistently identify and resolve ambiguous business, technical, operational, and organizational issues. You also build these capabilities in your team and your stakeholders.
• An instinct for building durable operating mechanisms rather than relying on personal heroics: clear ownership, decision forums, execution cadences, risk management, and accountability.
• Exceptional communication and influence skills. You build trust with your TPM peers and with senior engineering leaders, surface difficult issues directly, create clarity in ambiguity, and align teams around shared outcomes.
• Curiosity and practical fluency with AI-enabled ways of working, with a point of view on how technology can improve execution and unlock new strategic possibilities.
• Experience operating effectively with globally distributed teams and across different organizational cultures, time zones, and business contexts.

jobs.description: Senior Director, Treasury About the Role TD SYNNEX is seeking a Senior Director, Treasury to lead core treasury operations across cash, liquidity, debt, and foreign exchange. Own cash flow forecasting and variance analysis; deliver timely, accurate liquidity reporting and insights to leadership. Manage and cultivate banking relationships; negotiate services and fees, drive service-level excellence, and oversee KYC and account administration. Oversee letters of credit, guarantees, and trade finance instruments; ensure timely issuance, renewals, and compliance. Assess and manage foreign exchange exposures; develop and execute hedging strategies aligned to policy; monitor hedge effectiveness. Oversee interest rate risk management, evaluate debt portfolio positioning, and recommend hedging or refinancing strategies as needed. Design and implement cash management processes and services; champion automation and TMS utilization to improve control and efficiency. Evaluate treasury products, services, and systems; recommend and implement fit-for-purpose solutions. Maintain strong internal controls, documentation, and policy compliance (including SOX, audit support, and regulatory requirements). Establish and track treasury KPIs and dashboards; communicate performance and opportunities to stakeholders. Lead and coach team members; promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration. Perform additional duties as assigned to support treasury and broader finance initiatives. Hands-on experience with cash forecasting, working capital optimization, letters of credit/trade finance, and foreign exchange/hedging. Knowledge of interest rate risk, debt instruments, and short-term investments. Proficiency with Treasury Management Systems (TMS) and ERPs; strong Excel and analytical skills; familiarity with tools such as Kyriba, SAP, or Oracle is a plus. Proven leadership and team management experience; ability to influence cross-functionally and negotiate effectively. High attention to detail, confidentiality, and sound judgment; thrives in deadline-driven environments.
